timeline.summary: Ankur Ashwin Shah, Managing Director, declared no promoter share encumbrance under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Krishna Defence executed a shareholders agreement to acquire a 46.81% stake in Taharabadkar Solutions by subscribing to 8,800 shares at ₹4,546 each.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹64.85 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹12.81 Cr.
Krishna Defence issued its Q4 & FY26 earnings presentation targeting + CAGR growth over the next 3 to 5 years.
Krishna Defence and Allied Industries Limited shared its Post Earnings Conference Call recording held on 22 May 2026 via YouTube and company website.
Krishna Defence held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 22, 2026, highlighting strong financial performance and a 30%+ growth target.
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹132.89 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹26.76 Cr.
Krishna Defence presented Q2FY27 highlights, reiterating 30%+ CAGR multi-year guidance with an order book of ₹109 Cr and a ₹305 Cr tender pipeline.
Krishna Defence And Allied Industries Limited submitted the audio/video recording of its Post Investor Presentation Conference Call held on 30th October 2026.
